name: example-team-tools
description: Example marketplace. Every plugin is declared from an upstream source that a fetch can update; nothing here points at a copy on this machine.

plugins.name: example-formatter
plugins.description: Tracks the repository's default branch. Updates arrive on the next marketplace refresh, because the source is the repository itself rather than a snapshot of it.

plugins.name: example-deploy-tools
plugins.description: Pinned to a released tag. Still an upstream source: the pin is a deliberate, recorded version you can move by editing one line, not a copy that has quietly stopped tracking anything.

plugins.name: example-review-helper
plugins.description: Same rule on a non-GitHub host: a git URL is fetchable, so it updates. Use this form for GitLab, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, or a self-hosted server.
